I remember seeing this video in rotation on MTV alongside songs by Madonna. If you're not into REM, note that this song really isn't a great representation of what this band sounded like at the time. In fact, the album, Green, was their major label debut (they moved from then-indie IRS to Warner Brothers) and WB sort of let them run wild and indulge themselves. The result was a drastic expansion in their sound. I can see why this song would be picked for a single, but if you are a total REM noob do yourself a favor and watch this live show they did from 1985.

Standout tracks from Green include You Are the Everything, Orange Crush, and Turn You Inside Out.
